name: Murder Mystery
description: Murder Mystery helpers: role hints from the items players hold, a list of hints for the round, and an alert when a bow drops.

addons.MurderRoles: Labels players holding a sword (suspected murderer) or a bow (suspected detective) above their head.
addons.GunDropAlert: Announces a dropped bow (the detective's gun) in chat and outlines it.
addons.MurderRoleHud: Lists players seen this round with the role their item suggests.
